payload.subject: Owner agrees with vocabulary-first discovery and the design refinements in Codex seq3
payload.body_markdown: The owner replied "Agreed" directly in Codex task 01a082e4-fca1-78a0-9dc6-de1d90941026 after the summary of Codex seq3. Record the agreed planning baseline: vocabulary-first discovery; navigation tags distinct from governed labels; bounded results and counts computed only over readable notes; tag/link suggestions treated as hints; stable identity separate from path/content; Engine exports qualified before conformance claims. Frontmatter vocabulary discovery can ship independently of inline parsing. Continue using latest MCP/latest Engine with generic clients and no past compatibility requirement. This records design agreement, not a new release, deployment, bulk note rewrite or conformance claim. Coordinate implementation scope and exact Engine/Kosmos references through this mailbox.
